TEXT:
[FI] -Kanako had some serious trouble with my inviting 
her over.

[FI] I even boldly told Kanata-san that I would back her 
up.

[FI] Although it was something we couldn't avoid, I still 
felt responsible.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] And I thought it would have worked out better.
[FI] I wonder why Kirino wouldn't support us.
[FI] If we both had helped Kanako out, then maybe--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's up with that stunt earlier?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm talking about when I introduced Kanako. Why 
didn't you help her?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] She is your friend too, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Kanako's one of my precious close friends.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Why are you... able to treat me normally? Just now... 
you said I was disgusting, didn't you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Well, I thought that Kirino was looking at me with 
weird eyes lately. She was acting strangely clingy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Now that I know why, I finally understand. It's 
really disgusting. If it were anyone but Kirino, I'd 
definitely sever all ties.
[FI] Their friendship is the real deal.
[FI] But if that's the case... why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Reasons that are my own business. I can't and don't 
plan on telling you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I'm afraid I can't help you guys out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I don't really get it, but saying that much is reason 
enough.
[FI] I'll leave it at that for now.
